verdict.rationale: Exa's pricing docs describe a Free Tier that grants $10 in credits at sign-up (up to 2,500 Lite searches) and resets to $10 monthly, with no payment method required. The homepage offers "Try API for free", and the hosted MCP server needs no API key to start. A community user also reports signing up for a trial account and prototyping an agentic chatbot against the search API. missing for 10: consistent free-credit figures across pages (docs state $10, while pricing pages cite $20 on sign-up or a $10 onboarding bonus), documented free-tier rate limits.
